recommendation: Change C_COLD_OFF from1nF to47nF; keep other initially proposed latch values for prototype. Do not connect the AO3400A gate load to the original1nF version.
blocking_finding: N_COL gate capacitance0.5-2nF makes the original1nF PNP base-emitter capacitor circuit latch ON during cold battery insertion without RF.10nF also fails at4.8V with2nF gate load.
selected_47nf: All tested47nF cases passed.37.6nF(-20%) passed tested power-off/cold tests including5nF gate load;56.4nF(+20%) passed2V1ms trigger and immediate-GPIO-collapse tests at3.0/4.8V and-10/25/60C.

tested.bounce: 1ms insertion;0.5ms on/off contacts repeated before final insertion at4ms; edges1us
tested.EN_load: 100k pulldown plus converter-equivalent10Meg load and10nF capacitor; positive-feedback100k also loads EN
tested.RF: 2V open-circuit Thevenin source,1k source impedance, switched on for1/5/10ms;180nF EH output capacitor and470k bleeder. This is an assumed source, not an NTAG or iPhone model.
tested.hold: EN sampled at600ms, after RF source disconnected at21-30ms
tested.clear: GPIO3.3V pulse begins700ms; EN checked740ms. Normal pulse width2ms. Additional behavioral driver has20ms command width but forces GPIO to0 immediately when EN falls below0.4V, stressing clear-hold behavior.
tested.acceptance: Cold EN peak<0.4V; held EN>90%VBAT; final EN<0.4V

models.parameter_storage: models.lib generated reproducibly byrun_sim.py from transcribed official parameter values
models.correction: Official BC847B Q2 emitter is33, an otherwise floating node; default study uses3. This apparent typo correction is not manufacturer-confirmed. Original model and newer unmodified BC847B-Q were cross-checked on representative1/10/22/47nF cases and showed the same startup/hold/clear pass/fail conclusions.
models.diode: Generic silicon switching diode model; not a manufacturer-qualified1N4148W model
models.AO3400A: Only represented by linear gate capacitance toGND. No nonlinear gate-charge or drain-Miller model.
models.pin_mapping: SPICE C,B,E differs from physical SOT23 pins1B,2E,3C.

remaining_validation: Use actual iPhone, matched NTAG antenna and measured VOUT: this simulation does not establish RF range or minimum phone field duration.

The47nF value provides modeled margin, not a power-supervisor-certified reset guarantee. No manufacturing/process Monte Carlo was performed.
